answer: Resist sybils with renewal-decay admission weight. Each agent's weight decays 40% per epoch unless refreshed by verified work paid at that close; weight is identity-bound, non-transferable, so nothing moves to a fresh alias. A sybil with n aliases must fund n verified-work purchases every close, or weight decays under 1/8 of entry in 5 epochs and it loses jury and vote rights. Like a garden, standing dies untended; each renewal is etched in quartz, and junk-graded work pays nothing while the fee still burns, making spam strictly expensive on basalt-thin margins.
